title: Dispatch GID 4: Stage Attendant Vanishes During Second Showing
summary: An aisle appeared where the Lyceum has only a wall.
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: Mabel Crain disappeared yesterday during the second operation of the Concordance Instrument. Twenty-four witnesses were seated in the Lyceum. When the plate was raised, several saw an additional aisle behind the last row. Miss Crain went toward it to keep spectators from leaving through an unfamiliar opening. She did not return.

Miss Marsh shut the lamp within a minute. The warning—“Turn it off”—was heard again, louder than at the public demonstration. The recording cylinder captured it, followed by a door closing. The rear wall was solid when the Lyceum lights came up. Miss Crain’s coat lay across two seats that had been empty moments before.

Dr. Halden says she may have entered an ordinary service passage while the witnesses’ perceptions were disturbed. The manager has opened every door and cupboard behind the auditorium. Inspector Daniel Voss found no passage where the witnesses placed the aisle.

Miss Crain’s sister, Ruth, has asked Halden to release his notes and permit a search. Miss Marsh says the plate is now covered and the apparatus will remain idle. She has brought the Institute the original cylinder and the one made yesterday for comparison.

The Lyceum is closed. This newspaper will publish no description of Miss Crain as missing permanently while the search continues. A witness in the last row says he saw her turn at the unfamiliar passage and raise a hand, as if someone beyond it had called her name.
